happened: The administration used broad tariffs on all Chinese goods in 2025 and 2026 (see ch26-004). It also targeted specific firms: in September 2025 the Commerce Department widened export limits to affiliates of listed companies, but suspended that rule for one year in November 2025.
closeness: The action ran opposite to this free-trade recommendation, which favored firm-specific steps instead of blanket tariffs. Firm-specific export controls were used as well, not in place of tariffs.
uncertain: Tariff levels on China have changed often; see ch26-004 for the latest.
